label: abnormal body weight
description: anomaly in average weight compared to controls

label: premature death
description: death after weaning age, but before the normal life span (Mus: after 3 weeks of age)

label: abnormal heart morphology
description: any structural anomaly of the hollow, muscular organ that maintains the circulation of the blood

label: abnormal liver morphology
description: any structural anomaly of the bile-secreting organ that is important for detoxification, for fat, carbohydrate, and protein metabolism, and for glycogen storage

label: abnormal muscle morphology
description: any structural anomaly of the contractile tissue that produces movement in animals

label: abnormal kidney morphology
description: any structural anomaly of either of the two excretory organs that filter wastes (especially urea) from the blood and excrete them and water in urine

label: abnormal brain morphology
description: any structural anomaly of the brain, one of the two components of the central nervous system and the center of thought and emotion; controls coordination, bodily activities and the interpretation of information from the senses (sight, hearing, smell, etc.)

label: abnormal immune system physiology
description: deviation from the normal function of the immune system

label: abnormal nervous system physiology
description: any functional anomaly of the extensive, intricate network of electochemical structures in the body that is comprised of the brain, spinal cord, nerves, ganglia and parts of the receptor organs that receive and interpret stimuli and transmit impulses to effector organs to control body functions

label: abnormal locomotor behavior
description: altered ability or inability to move from place to place in response to stimuli

label: decreased fertility
description: A fertility which is relatively low.

label: infertility
description: This term is independent of any anomalies in mating behavior. Consider using abnormal sexual interaction MP:0002566 when anomalies in mating behavior are observed.

label: abnormal cell proliferation
description: anomaly in the ability of a cell population to undergo expansion by cell division

label: abnormal neuron differentiation
description: The definition of the previous ID MP:0006008 [abnormal neurogenesis] specified only the growth or development of neurons; this is not the accepted definition of neurogenesis in GO:0022008 or most dictionary resources; these include all cells of the nervous system including glia. A new term of abnormal neuron differentiation was created that matched the definition and MP:0006008 [abnormal neurogenesis] has been merged into it.

label: abnormal T cell physiology
description: any functional anomaly of lymphocytes that are responsible for cell-mediated immunity and immune system regulation

label: abnormal B cell physiology
description: any functional anomaly of lymphocytes that expresses membrane-bound antibody, and differentiate into antibody-secreting plasma cells and memory cells upon interaction with antigen; B cells are the primary lymphocyte responsible for humoral immunity, and are most effective against extracellular pathogens

label: abnormal blood circulation
description: failure or atypical movement in the flow of blood from the heart to the vasculature and back to the heart
